title: Commuting ordinary model square for local canonical evaluation
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] with derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] on $X$ and all opens, and $K,N\in D(\mathcal O_X)$. Let $U$ be open and $P$ strictly perfect [def-pc-perfect-complex] with $K|_U\cong QP$. Write $R$ for exact restriction, $H$ for derived internal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom], $D=H(K,\mathcal O_X)$, and $g$ for the canonical adjunct of $\alpha;1_N\otimes\mathrm{ev};\rho$ using the family of [def-pc-canonical-derived-tensor-hom-bijection] and the shared tensor [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure]. There exist a complex $F$ representing $RN$, a chain map $f:\operatorname{Tot}(F\otimes\mathcal Hom^\bullet(P,\mathcal O_U[0]))\to\mathcal Hom^\bullet(P,F)$ with the component formula specified in [lem-pc-strictly-perfect-ordinary-evaluation], and comparison isomorphisms $a:R(N\otimes D)\cong Q\operatorname{Tot}(F\otimes\mathcal Hom^\bullet(P,\mathcal O_U[0]))$ and $b:RH(K,N)\cong Q\mathcal Hom^\bullet(P,F)$, such that $R(g);b= a;Q(f)$. Invertibility of $f$ is not asserted.

proof.text: Let Q be the derived localization on the localized module category. Set F=Q.objPreimage(RN), with the inverse of Q.objObjPreimageIso as the representative isomorphism RN to QF. This uses essential surjectivity of the existing derived localization; no arbitrary complex is selected from an unproved existence theorem.
Construct f using the actual degree maps E^n and their named differential identity. The proved coproduct inclusion and product lift formulas give IsLocalOrdinaryEvaluation for this chain map.

Extract the given isomorphism RK to QP and apply the compatible-comparison theorem to P,F,f, strict perfectness, both representatives and the verified evaluation formula. Combine the resulting a,b and square with F, its representative and the constructed f.
